prompt: This is the heart of the Pratt loop: look at the next operator, stop if it binds too loosely, otherwise parse its right side and fold it into `lhs`. One line does not belong.
explain: The loop peeks for an infix operator, breaks when its left power is below `min_bp`, consumes it, and parses the right operand with the operator's right power, which is what controls associativity. Restarting with 0 would let the right side swallow everything.
